summary: Verified new Backup-Reminder feature (frontend only). All 8 requested scenarios PASSED. Home banner 'Backup empfohlen' correctly appears when no backup has ever been done (shows 'Sie haben noch nie ein Datei-Backup erstellt.'). The /backup/ screen renders the new 'Erinnerung an neues Backup' section with all 6 chips (Aus / Täglich / Alle 3 Tage / Wöchentlich / Alle 2 Wochen / Monatlich) and 'Wöchentlich' is the default active (green) chip. Tapping 'Aus (keine Erinnerung)' persists 0 to AsyncStorage key aufmassprofi_backup_reminder_days and hides the banner on home. Tapping 'Täglich' persists 1 and makes the banner reappear. The X-icon dismiss removes the banner in-session and it returns after reload. Setting aufmassprofi_last_file_backup to a recent ISO date shows 'Letztes Backup: ...' on /backup/ and hides the banner on home (daysSince < interval). Banner 'Sichern' tap does NOT crash the web preview (UnavailabilityError from expo-sharing is caught silently). No red screens, no regressions in home/backup loading.

issues: Dismiss (X) icon is only ~18px with hitSlop 8 => effective ~34px touch area, below 44px iOS minimum. Recommend increasing hitSlop to {top:12,bottom:12,left:12,right:12} or wrapping in a Pressable with padding:10.

Copy 'Letzte Sicherung vor 0 Tagen' would appear if a backup was done <24h ago AND interval=1. Consider a friendlier 'heute' / 'weniger als 1 Tag' string when daysSince=0 with an interval that already met threshold (edge case).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings observed on load: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not caused by this feature but should be tracked. Reference: multiple components using shadowColor/shadowOffset.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: enlarge the banner-dismiss X touch target (currently 18px icon with hitSlop 8 → below 44px HIG guideline). Increase hitSlop or wrap in a padded TouchableOpacity.

OPTIONAL copy tweak in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line ~787: when daysSince===0 and last backup exists but interval elapsed, current sentence would read 'Letzte Sicherung vor 0 Tagen.' – consider 'heute' phrasing.
critical_code_review_comments: BackupService.exportFullBackup persists aufmassprofi_last_file_backup only after successful writeAsStringAsync + Sharing.shareAsync. On web preview Sharing.isAvailableAsync returns false so shareAsync is skipped and timestamp IS still written (good – tested indirectly).

In app/index.tsx handleBackupNow(): setBackupDueDays(null) is called only on success. On failure (web UnavailabilityError from FileSystem writeAsStringAsync via cacheDirectory being null) the error is only console.warned – no user-visible feedback. Acceptable per requirement, but on native an Alert would improve UX.

isBackupDue returns { due:true, daysSince:null } when no backup exists; home converts null to 0 via 'status.daysSince || 0'. UI then uses backupDueDays===0 to show the 'never backed up' copy. Works but is fragile — if a backup was actually 0 days ago and still due (impossible with current logic since 0 < any positive interval), the same '0' would mean two different things. Consider using an explicit sentinel (e.g. -1 for 'never').
seed_data_creation: During tests: seeded aufmassprofi_settings.disclaimer_accepted_at/disclaimer_version='2026-06' via localStorage to bypass disclaimer modal; toggled aufmassprofi_backup_reminder_days (0/1) and aufmassprofi_last_file_backup (ISO now) to exercise banner states.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified on Expo web preview. AsyncStorage on web maps to window.localStorage with identical keys. Disclaimer modal (DisclaimerGate v2026-06) blocks clicks – pre-seed aufmassprofi_settings with disclaimer_accepted_at + disclaimer_version='2026-06' before UI interaction. Banner state is driven by aufmassprofi_backup_reminder_days (0=off) and aufmassprofi_last_file_backup (ISO string).
rca_of_issue: No bug — feature works as specified.
